name: Discord Rich Presence
description: Show what you're doing on Biketerra on your Discord profile: your ride (route/event, distance, elapsed time), spectating, or the page you're on (dashboard/results). Uses the Terra core to talk to Discord desktop directly — no sidecar. Needs a Discord application Client ID and the Discord desktop client running on the same machine (Linux).

settings.label: Discord application Client ID
settings.description: discord.com/developers/applications > your app > General Information > Client ID. Create the app (free, no OAuth needed) to be able to show custom presence.

settings.label: Large image key
settings.description: Optional key of an image uploaded under Rich Presence > Assets in your app. Leave it blank (or use a key you haven't uploaded) and Discord falls back to your app's icon.

settings.label: Update interval (seconds)
settings.description: How often presence updates may be pushed. Keep it >= 15 to stay clear of Discord's rate limits.

settings.label: Show idle presence (dashboard, results, …)
settings.description: When not riding or spectating, show the Biketerra page you're on (e.g. 'On dashboard', 'Browsing routes', 'Viewing results'). Turn off for ride/spectate presence only.
